card.name: Place names and geographic landforms
card.fires_on: Words inside or right after geographic place names and landform terms (Valley, Rock, Desert, Eastern) in history and geography text. It also fires on words describing a region, such as 'the earth' or 'rich' in a regional description.

modes.label: Landform names
modes.description: A landform word completes or follows a named place.

modes.label: Region descriptions
modes.description: A word within a phrase describing a region or area of the world.
modes.example: China seems like another region of the<< earth>> from Europe.

card.writes: It suppresses geographic and location words, so it lowers the chance that another place-term follows.
card.plain: It lights up in history or geography passages when the text is in the middle of naming or describing a place or region.
